title: Colony (84)
problem: The loop goes over the side's party slots and makes each other Griffon Defend if it isn't already Defending. There is no Health / dead check, so dead Griffons "Defend" too (and their on-defend effects can run).
notes: Community claim: Triggers on dead Griffons too, without Life After Death. Evidence: bc_OnDefend L442-L456: race == Griffon && side has 84 @0x14153e1b5 / 0x14153e25f; loop tests isdefending @0x14153e3a9 and race @0x14153e447 only; bc_CreatureDefend(…, 1) @0x14153e51a. Fix sketch: Add a hp > 0 test to the loop (H) Triage 2026-10-26: Dead Griffons Defend too. Hook: add hp > 0 to the loop. | In-game test: Colony team with one dead Griffon: when another Griffon defends, the dead one does not Defend.

release_notes.intended: After one of your Griffons defends, the rest of them defend as well.
release_notes.actual: In the unpatched game, dead Griffons defended too.
